item.description:
Fixes a crash, and today's token count.

  • AgentDock no longer quits when Claude Code's hook reports an event. With "Know when Claude Code needs you" turned on, 0.5.3 and 0.5.4 crashed on the first event from any session started afterwards.
  • Today's tokens are counted once. Resumed and forked sessions copy earlier messages into new files, and those were counted again, as was the history a resumed Codex thread carries into its new file. Totals were up to 40% too high.
  • The hover card says how much was re-read from cache. Every request sends the whole conversation again, mostly from the prompt cache, which is why daily totals run into the hundreds of millions.

Codex app threads open where they are.

  • Clicking a Codex app thread opens that thread in the Codex app, from the strip or an Inbox card.
  • Threads in the current Codex app are recognised as the app's. It now runs them through a copy of the Codex CLI it carries inside, so AgentDock took them for a terminal session and clicking did nothing.
  • Release notes are back: 0.5.2 and 0.5.3 went out without them.

Also new since 0.5.1:

  • ⌘-click an agent on the strip to go straight to it, and choose in Settings › General what a plain click does. Inbox cards have a button that takes you to the agent.
  • Settings is in tabs at one size, with Settings › Apps: what works in each app and terminal, how to set it up, and whether it's ready on this Mac.
